pay_note: Starting basic pay of FY 2082/83, rounded. Dearness, grade and field allowances come on top and change with each budget.

stages: Preliminary test: 50 multiple choice questions, 45 minutes, 20 percent negative marking. Pass mark 45. These marks are not added to the final merit.
Contemporary studies and public service management. Short and long answers, 2 hours 30 minutes, pass mark 40.
Service related subject. Short and long answers, 2 hours 30 minutes, pass mark 40.
Computer skill test of 10 marks and an oral interview of 30 marks. Final merit adds written, computer and interview marks.

g-police.note: Constable, ASI and Inspector each have their own age, education and test plan. Read the current notice from Nepal Police; seat numbers and age limits change between notices.

g-army.note: Soldier, technical and officer cadet entries each have their own notice. Age limits are strict and counted on the last application date.

govt_add.name: Nepal Police Inspector
govt_add.need: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university
govt_add.age: About 20 to 25 years. The exact limit is printed in each notice
govt_add.body: Nepal Police with the Public Service Commission
stages: Application screening and basic health measures. No marks.
Timed fitness test followed by a detailed medical check. Qualifying only.
50 multiple choice questions (25 reasoning, 25 general knowledge), 2 marks each, 0.4 negative marking, 50 minutes. Pass mark 40.
Nepali 50 marks and English 50 marks, 3 hours. At least 20 marks in each part.
Police work, laws, investigation, security management. Pass mark 40.
prep: Build running stamina months before the notice
Practise reasoning and general knowledge with timed sets
Write short essays in Nepali and English every week
Read the police act, criminal code and investigation basics
govt_add.note: The age limit is strict. A candidate who is even a few days over on the last application date is rejected.

govt_add.name: Nepal Police ASI
govt_add.level: Assistant Sub Inspector, non gazetted first class
govt_add.need: +2 or equivalent from a recognised board
govt_add.age: About 18 to 25 years. The exact limit is printed in each notice
govt_add.body: Nepal Police with the Public Service Commission
stages: Application screening and basic health measures. No marks.
General knowledge 50 and reasoning 50. Pass mark 40.
Police introduction, security management, investigation, laws and complaints. Pass mark 40.
Detailed health check and an oral interview before the merit list.
prep: Do timed reasoning sets
Revise Nepal facts, constitution and current affairs
Practise grammar and short writing in both languages
Keep up daily running and fitness
govt_add.note: ASI can be promoted to Sub Inspector and then Inspector through seniority and departmental exams.

govt_add.name: Armed Police Force ASI
govt_add.age: About 18 to 23 years. The exact limit is printed in each notice
stages: First screening of height, weight and basic standards. No marks.
Fitness and endurance test. Qualifying only.
Pass mark is 40 percent, which is 120 of 300.
A second medical check for candidates who passed the written exam.
Oral interview before the final list.
prep: Train for the physical test first, it removes many applicants
Practise timed mock papers
Revise Nepal facts and the constitution
Read the syllabus printed in the notice
govt_add.note: The Armed Police Force also recruits doctors, nurses, accountants and legal officers through separate notices.

govt_add.name: Nepali Army officer cadet
govt_add.need: +2 with maths in SEE, or a bachelor's degree. Unmarried at the time of application
govt_add.age: 18 to 21 years with +2, 18 to 24 years with a bachelor's degree
stages: Push up, sit up, chin up and a timed run. Qualifying only.
English, mathematics and Nepali of 100 marks each, plus general knowledge of 100 marks.
Technical officer test, group tasking, interviewing officer and board interview.
Medical check, then about 18 months of officer cadet training at Kharipati, Bhaktapur.
prep: Work on maths and English, each is a separate full paper
Build running and bodyweight fitness early
Practise group discussion and speaking with confidence
Read the physical standards in the notice before you train
govt_add.note: The latest notice listed 280 seats. Seat numbers change with each notice.

govt_add.name: Nepal Rastra Bank Assistant and Assistant Director
govt_add.need: +2 for Assistant. Bachelor or master as each group's notice says for Assistant Director
govt_add.age: 18 to 35 years for Assistant, 21 to 35 years for Assistant Director. Women get extra years as the notice says
govt_add.body: Nepal Rastra Bank with the Public Service Commission
stages: Multiple choice screening paper, used for administration posts when applicants are many.
Subjective papers on banking, economics, accounting or technology by group.
Final stage supervised by the Public Service Commission.
prep: Read the group syllabus on the NRB site
Revise monetary policy and banking law
Solve past questions under time
Apply before the double fee period ends
govt_add.note: Application fee is NPR 800 for Assistant and NPR 1,000 for Assistant Director, with a smaller fee for each extra reserved group. Late applications pay double.

guides.name: Citizenship certificate
steps: Ask your ward office for a recommendation
Take parents' citizenship and birth proof to the District Administration Office
Wait for verification and collect the certificate

guides.name: National ID
steps: Fill the pre enrolment form online
Visit an enrolment centre for photo and fingerprints
Collect the card when it is ready

guides.name: E-passport
steps: Fill the online form and book a date
Pay the fee: from NPR 5,000 for a 34 page passport, more for 66 pages or urgent service
Visit the office for fingerprints and photo

guides.name: Apply to a Lok Sewa notice
steps: Read the vacancy notice and check your age and education
Create or open your profile on the commission site
Upload documents and pay the notice fee online
Download the admit card and sit the first paper

guides.name: Apply for an Indian Embassy scholarship
steps: Watch the embassy notice for the yearly window
Register on the scholarship portal and fill the form
Upload SEE or +2 transcripts and citizenship
Print the submission slip and wait for the merit list

guides.name: Check a college before paying
steps: Confirm the programme is listed with its university, council or CTEVT
Ask for the official fee sheet and compare it with the regulator's fee cap
Pay only against a numbered receipt
Keep admission and fee records until you graduate
